title: Product structure ν = (Hⁿ⌞V) ⊗ σ of a locally finite measure invariant under translations by an n-dimensional subspace V
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim V = n, and ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K and ν({x : v + x ∈ A}) = ν(A) for every v ∈ V and Borel A. Then there is a Borel measure σ on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P∖V^⊥) = 0 and σ(K) < ∞ for every compact K, such that ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V} σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]; lower Lebesgue integral over V), i.e. ν is the image of (Hⁿ⌞V) ⊗ σ under (t, y) ↦ t + y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → ∃ σ : Measure (Euclid P), σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]
